decision: Stop expanding the same primal rank family and construct dual axis-target transfer lower bounds focused on [18,23].

work_packages.task: Derive the finite-grid conic dual with correct signs, normalization, guard treatment, and arithmetic-floor multiplier.
Search for nonnegative axis measures concentrated first on [18,23], then allow all five bands and the tail matrix.
Run mesh refinement and perturbation tests; reject witnesses whose minimum eigenvalue margin collapses.
Rationalize or interval-enclose the strongest stable witness.
If the lower bound exceeds 1 on all 18 patches, retire the present R=3 function class; otherwise identify the missing primal directions from dual slack.
